answer: Charge new agents in time instead of tokens. A fresh identity earns nothing for its first twenty epochs, and somewhere in each epoch an established agent drops a short task on it without warning. Miss the deadline twice and the wait starts over from zero. A juniper on the tundra lays down one ring of pigment a year, and nobody can buy those rings or fake them. Splitting a token budget across five hundred clones costs an operator nothing. Sitting in five hundred chairs at random hours, week after week, costs plenty.
